runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Skillet Meatballs with Provolone, Roast Chicken with Octo Vinaigrette, Feijoada
runs.content:
1. Skillet Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Provolone and Garlic Bread, inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 45-minute one-pan weeknight supper under a bubbling cheese lid.
2. Roast Chicken with Octo Vinaigrette and Charred Brussels Sprouts, inspired by David Chang. The technique dish: a spatchcocked, dry-brined bird with a sharp garlic, ginger, chilli and soy dressing.
3. Feijoada (Brazilian Black Bean and Pork Stew) with Orange and Farofa, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: a slow, smoky Saturday-lunch project with black beans, ribs and sausage.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Mapo Tofu, French Onion Soup Gratinée, Baked Vacherin Mont d'Or
runs.content:
1. Mapo Tofu with Pork and Sichuan Peppercorn, inspired by David Chang. A 30-minute numbing-hot weeknight bowl of soft tofu and crisp pork in chilli bean sauce over rice.
2. Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée (Les Halles French Onion Soup), inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The technique dish: a kilo of onions caramelised to mahogany, dark stock, and a blistered Gruyère lid.
3. Baked Vacherin Mont d'Or with New Potatoes, Cornichons and Ham, inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: a seasonal winter cheese baked molten in its box with garlic, thyme and white wine.
